title: Track Drive Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the track drive: torque, brake and speed limits.

pass_damage.description: Whether damage is passed to the owning sub-part.

limit_damage.description: Whether passed damage is limited by the remaining subsystem durability.

hidden.description: Whether this subsystem is hidden from HUD displays.

control_inputs.description: TrackControlSignal input channels, ordered by priority.

max_drive_torque.description: Maximum drive torque at the rolling joint, in N*m.

max_brake_torque.description: Maximum service brake torque, in N*m.

max_hand_brake_torque.description: Maximum parking brake torque, in N*m.

max_speed.description: Maximum driven wheel angular speed, in rad/s.
